0.content: Ayato is head of the Kamisato Clan and Yashiro Commissioner, and Thoma's lord. Ten years ago, amid a succession dispute after his parents' deaths, Ayato warned Thoma to leave if he did not want to be drawn into the clan's troubles. He says now that this was partly to see where Thoma stood. Thoma refused and received his Vision that night. Ayato says few people have his complete trust, and Thoma is one of them. Thoma, for his part, keeps an eye on Ayato at home and says his lord takes no joy in political battles; for him they are "a matter of duty".

1.content: Thoma is Ayaka's attendant and friend; she calls him a dear friend whose sunny disposition lifts her spirits, another brother and a full member of the clan. He and Yoimiya are her only known friends before the Traveler. He carries out her wishes, and in 2.0 he was her go-between with the Traveler. When he was seized for the Vision Hunt Ceremony she wanted to rescue him herself, remembering how they had all just eaten hotpot together, but the Traveler went instead to protect the Yashiro Commission's neutrality. He wishes she would voice her own opinions more and advises friends to keep asking for them.

2.content: Beidou left the Traveler in Thoma's care at Ritou. He tested their resolve with a deliberately impossible path out of the port, then apologised and took them to Ayaka. After the Traveler fought the Raiden Shogun at the Vision Hunt Ceremony to save his Vision, he swore them his weapon and his loyalty, promising to fight for them "no matter what". He treats them as a close friend: he invites them to birthday parties, worries they are not eating properly on the road, and admits his homesickness to them.

3.content: In the 2.0 Archon Quest the Tenryou Commission took Thoma to the Statue of the Omnipresent God to be the 100th Vision bearer stripped under the Vision Hunt Decree, at a ceremony the Raiden Shogun attended in person. His Vision was already floating toward her hand when the Traveler intercepted it. The Shogun overwhelmed the Traveler; Thoma freed himself, hurled a polearm at her and fled carrying the Traveler. Both became wanted. He sent the Traveler to the Watatsumi resistance and hid at Komore Teahouse, inside Yashiro territory. He later said that without the Traveler he would have lost his Vision "and with it all my aspirations".

4.content: Thoma's mother, Ulrike, is a Mondstadt-born Knight of Favonius, described by Kaeya as free-spirited, thoughtful, gentle and kind, "the very model of a Knight", and able to drink most sailors under the table. Her favourite tavern is Angel's Share. After the Sakoku Decree lifted, she and Thoma wrote often; she once demanded Inazuman wines to taste what he drinks. By 5.7 she had received orders to join Grand Master Varka's expedition camp in Nod-Krai, and the Knights threw her a packed farewell party. His father is Inazuman, taught him loyalty and righteousness, and returned to Inazuma; Thoma could never find him there.
